description: This file contains utility functions for crash upload operations, including retrieving system information such as MAC address, IP address, uptime, model number, and performing system reboot. It also sources configuration scripts and defines external command calls.

methods.name: getLastModifiedTimeOfFile
methods.description: Returns the last modified time of a specified file in a formatted string.

methods.name: Timestamp
methods.description: Returns the current date and time in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format.

methods.name: getMacAddressOnly
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the device based on device type and box type.

methods.name: getSHA1
methods.description: Calculates and returns the SHA1 checksum of a given file.

methods.name: getIPAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of the device, considering IPv6 status and box type.

methods.name: processCheck
methods.description: Checks if a process with a given name is running; returns 1 if not running, 0 if running.

methods.name: getMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the CM interface.

methods.name: getErouterMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the eRouter interface.

methods.name: rebootFunc
methods.description: Reboots the system, optionally with specified process and reason.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the model number of the device from version.txt.
